preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(s) % 2 == 1 and 1 <= len(s) <= 49 for s, _ in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each string s has an odd length between 1 and 49 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(c) == 1 and c.islower() for _, c in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each target character c is a single lowercase Latin letter.
Each string s consists only of lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.expression: all((stdout_lines[i] == 'YES') == (c in s) for i, (s, c) in enumerate(test_cases))
postconditions.description: For each test case, output 'YES' if and only if the target character c appears at least once in the original string s.
